trap.label: rentabilidade
trap.wrong: The rentability of the fund can fall as well as rise.
trap.right: The return on the fund can fall as well as rise.
trap.why: Em português “rentabilidade” parece ter correspondente em inglês, mas o termo usual é return (retorno). Rentability não se usa.

mcq.q: “Past performance is not a ___ to future results.”
“You may get back ___ than you invest.”

fix.wrong: Funds can falls as well as rise.
fix.right: Funds can fall as well as rise.

fix.wrong: You may to get back less.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com may: “Maybe you get back less.”
Reescreva com can: “It is possible for value to rise or fall.”
Reescreva com subject to: “Limits apply to this offer.”
rewrite.answer: This offer is subject to limits.
